name: Rocket Stick Minis - Injected Pre Roll Pack (5 x 0.6g) - Orange Creamsicle
description:
Big flavor, mini size. The Rocket Stick Minis Orange Creamsicle pack gives you five 0.6-gram infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing with friends, or keeping a few on hand.

Orange Creamsicle nails that frozen-treat nostalgia: bright, juicy orange up front swirled with smooth vanilla cream and a sweet, mellow finish. It's a sweet-meets-citrus classic built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

5 × 0.6G infused minis — 3G total, quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Signature Orange Creamsicle flavor — juicy orange swirled with smooth vanilla cream
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every mini. Rocket Stick Minis Orange Creamsicle is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
